**What do you want to achieve?**
Describe the outcome, not just the implementation.

**Which layer does it affect?**
- [ ] Risk Board
- [ ] World Map
- [ ] Human Layer
- [ ] Data / update pipeline
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

**Why does this matter?**
How does it improve legibility of power structures, intent or control?

**Possible approach (optional)**
Your ideas are welcome, but not required.
